words-to-pages.name: Words to pages
words-to-pages.blurb: How many pages a word count fills.

title-case.a1: A way of capitalizing titles: the important words start with a capital letter and short words such as a, the, and, of and in stay lowercase. Each style guide draws the line a little differently.
title-case.q2: What is the difference between APA and MLA title case?
title-case.a2: APA capitalizes every word of four letters or more, so it writes "Studies From 2010". MLA lowercases all prepositions, whatever their length ("Studies from 2010"), and always capitalizes the last word, so "What It's Made Of" ends with a capital in MLA but not in APA.
title-case.q3: When do I use sentence case?
title-case.a3: In APA 7 reference lists, the titles of articles, books and web pages are in sentence case: only the first word, the first word after a colon and proper nouns are capitalized. Titles of your own paper and its headings use title case.
title-case.q4: Does the converter keep acronyms and names?
title-case.a4: It keeps words written with capitals inside them, such as DNA, COVID-19, iPhone and McDonald. It cannot tell that a lowercase word is a name, so in sentence case check proper nouns like Freud or Europe and capitalize them yourself.
title-case.a5: Words like up, out and over are prepositions in some titles and part of a verb in others. The converter treats them as prepositions. When one belongs to a verb, as in "Growing Up" or "Setting Up", capitalize it by hand.

words-to-pages.a1: In Times New Roman 12 pt with 1-inch margins on Letter paper, 1,000 words fill about 2.8 pages double-spaced and 1.4 pages single-spaced. In Arial 12 pt it is about 3.1 and 1.6 pages.
words-to-pages.q2: How many words are on a page?
words-to-pages.a2: About 350 words on a double-spaced page and 700 on a single-spaced page in Times New Roman 12 pt with 1-inch margins. Wider fonts hold fewer: about 320 and 640 in Arial, and 240 and 490 in Courier New.
words-to-pages.q3: Why is this more than the usual 250 words per page?
words-to-pages.a3: The 250 words per double-spaced page rule comes from typewriters, whose Courier letters are all the same width. Courier New 12 pt still gives about 240 words a page. Times New Roman is much narrower, so a line holds about 15 words instead of 10.
words-to-pages.q4: How exact is the page count?
words-to-pages.a4: For pasted text the tool lays out your own words with the font's real letter widths and Word's line heights, so the count is usually within a few lines. For a bare word count it uses an average English text; short or long words, headings, quotations and reference lists change the result.
words-to-pages.q5: Does it work for Chinese, Japanese or Korean text?
words-to-pages.a5: Pasted text in these languages is laid out with each character one em wide, as word processors do. Documents in these languages often use a document grid or other fonts, so treat the result as an estimate.

titleCase.title: Title case converter
titleCase.privacyNote: APA, MLA, Chicago and AP title case, and sentence case. Converted in your browser.
titleCase.rule_apa: APA: capitalize words of four letters or more and all nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs and pronouns; lowercase articles and conjunctions and prepositions of up to three letters.
titleCase.rule_mla: MLA: lowercase articles, all prepositions, coordinating conjunctions (and, but, for, nor, or, so, yet) and to; capitalize the first and last word.
titleCase.rule_chicago: Chicago: lowercase articles, all prepositions, and, but, for, or, nor, to and as; capitalize the first and last word.
titleCase.rule_ap: AP: capitalize words of four letters or more; lowercase articles and conjunctions and prepositions of up to three letters, except as the first or last word.
titleCase.rule_sentence: Sentence case: capitalize only the first word, the first word after a colon, acronyms and proper nouns.
titleCase.inputHint: Each line is converted on its own. The first word and the first word after a colon are always capitalized.
titleCase.limits: Names written in lowercase and verbs like "set up" cannot be detected: check them before you copy.
